hero.filename: St Ann's Square floral tribute panorama (01).jpg
hero.caption: A panorama picture of the floral tribute to the victims of the 2017 Manchester Arena bombing at St Anne's Square in Manchester city centre. The picture was taken from the west side of St Anne's Square, with Exchange St visible to the left-hand side and St Anne's Church to the right-hand side.
hero.alt: A panorama picture of the floral tribute to the victims of the 2017 Manchester Arena bombing at St Anne's Square in Manchester city centre. The picture was taken from the west side of St Anne's Square, with Exchange St visible to the left-hand side and St Anne's Church to the right-hand side.

images.filename: The Glade of Light memorial in Manchester, Salford view.jpg
images.caption: A panorama picture of The Glade of Light memorial in Manchester, England, commemorating the victims of the 2017 Manchester Arena bombing. This picture was taken from the east (main) side of the memorial towards the river Irwell and the city of Salford. The glass building in the background is 100 Embankment, a new office building on the Salford side of the Irwell.
images.alt: A panorama picture of The Glade of Light memorial in Manchester, England, commemorating the victims of the 2017 Manchester Arena bombing. This picture was taken from the east (main) side of the memorial towards the river Irwell and the city of Salford. The glass building in the background is 100 Embankment, a new office building on the Salford side of the Irwell.

images.filename: Minuto de silencio en solidaridad con las víctimas del atentado de Manchester (01).jpg
images.caption: El Ayuntamiento de Madrid ha guardado hoy martes, 23 de mayo, a las 12 horas, en la puerta del Palacio de Cibeles un minuto de silencio para condenar el atentado de ayer lunes en Manchester. A esa hora la alcaldesa de Madrid, Manuela Carmena, y otros miembros de la corporación y trabajadores municipales han mostrado su rechazo en la puerta del Palacio de Cibeles.
